claims: Free from Cloudflare, just open sourced, ~21,000 GitHub stars
Cloudflare started its own bug-hunting system with this skill
Maps the entire app, then sends separate agents to hunt specific problems (prompt injection, seeing another user's data)
Each finding goes to a new agent whose only job is to prove it wrong; only surviving bugs are reported
Writes a report and implements fixes; best practice is to run it more than once
how_to_steps: Paste the install command in your terminal (not shown)
Open the project in your coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Lovable)
Review SECURITY-REPORT.md (Confirmed / Needs checking / Rejected) and the patched files
Re-run the audit more than once

relevance.why: A free, vendor-backed, multi-agent audit with a verifier pass is exactly the kind of pre-ship check Haji needs and lacks time to do by hand.

implement_score.why: If the repo is real: install the skill once, run '/audit' on each app before release and after big AI-written changes. Low effort, high leverage. Pair with the liked login-gap checklist and the gitleaks step.

verify: Does github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill exist and is it Cloudflare-official? The 21k-star claim is suspicious for a brand-new repo (card shows Issues 19, 0 Tags)
What is the install command and which agents does it support (Claude Code skill format?)
Does it really auto-patch code, or only report? Auto-patching needs review
Token cost of a full multi-agent audit on a mid-size app

gap.what: New tool: Cloudflare's security-audit-skill with hunter + verifier agent architecture. Liked set had Strix, AppBully and the 818-skill cybersecurity pack, not this one.
